instrument powder_diffractometer {
    // Instrument parameters
    parameter double lambda = 2.5666;
    parameter double R = 0.87;
    parameter double R_curve = 0.87;
    parameter string filename = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz";
    parameter double D_PHI = 6;
    parameter double SHIFT = 0;
    parameter double PACK = 0.7;
    parameter double Dw = 0.8;
    parameter double BARNS = 1;
    parameter int SPLITS = 58;

    // Constants and derived quantities
    const double mono_q = 1.8734;
    const double y_mono = 0.025;
    const int NV = 5;
    const double sample_radius = 0.008/2;
    const double sample_height = 0.03;
    const double can_radius = 0.0083/2;
    const double can_height = 0.0303;
    const double can_thick = 0.00015;
    const double Qc = 0.0217;
    const double R0 = 0.995;
    const double Mvalue = 1.9;
    const double W = 1.0/250.0;
    const double Qc_curve = 0.0217;
    const double R0_curve = 0.995;
    const double Mvalue_curve = 2.1;
    const double W_curve = 1.0/250.0;
    const double ldiff = 0.05;

    // Derived values from the C code
    double TTM = 2 * asin(mono_q * lambda / (4 * PI)) * 180 / PI;
    double OMA = TTM / 2;
    double RV = 2 * 2.82 * sin(OMA * PI / 180);

    double angleGuideCurved = -2.0 * asin(0.4995 / 2.0 / 3612) * 180 / PI;
    double alpha = (R0 - R) / Qc / (Mvalue - 1);
    double alpha_curve = (R0_curve - R_curve) / Qc_curve / (Mvalue_curve - 1);

    // Set random seed for reproducibility
    set_seed(123456789);

    // Source arm
    Progress_bar source_arm(AT=(0, 0, 0), RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE, ROTATED=(0, 0, 0), RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE);

    // Source
    Source_Maxwell_3 source(
        AT=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=source_arm,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=source_arm,
        yheight=0.156,
        xwidth=0.126,
        Lmin=lambda - ldiff / 2,
        Lmax=lambda + ldiff / 2,
        dist=1.725,
        focus_xw=0.02,
        focus_yh=0.12,
        T1=296.16,
        T2=40.68,
        I1=8.5e11,
        I2=5.2e11
    );

    // PSD before guides
    PSD_monitor PSDbefore_guides(
        AT=(0, 0, 1.49999),
        RELATIVE=source_arm,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nx=128,
        ny=128,
        filename="PSDbefore_guides",
        xwidth=0.02,
        yheight=0.12,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // Wavelength monitor at source
    L_monitor l_mon_source(
        AT=(0, 0, 1e-9),
        RELATIVE=PSDbefore_guides,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nL=101,
        filename="lmonsource.dat",
        xwidth=0.02,
        yheight=0.12,
        Lmin=0,
        Lmax=20,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // Guide 1
    Guide guide1(
        AT=(0, 0, 1.50),
        RELATIVE=source_arm,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=source_arm,
        w1=0.02,
        h1=0.12,
        w2=0.02,
        h2=0.12,
        l=4.66,
        R0=R0,
        Qc=Qc,
        alpha=alpha,
        m=1.8,
        W=W
    );

    // PSD before curve
    PSD_monitor PSDbefore_curve(
        AT=(0, 0, 4.664),
        RELATIVE=guide1,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nx=128,
        ny=128,
        filename="PSDbefore_curve",
        xwidth=0.02,
        yheight=0.12,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // Guide 2 (Bender)
    Bender guide2(
        AT=(0, 0, 4.69),
        RELATIVE=guide1,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        w=0.02,
        h=0.12,
        r=3612,
        l=20,
        R0a=R0_curve,
        Qca=Qc_curve,
        alphaa=alpha_curve,
        ma=Mvalue_curve,
        Wa=W_curve,
        R0i=R0_curve,
        Qci=Qc_curve,
        alphai=alpha_curve,
        mi=1,
        Wi=W_curve,
        R0s=R0_curve,
        Qcs=Qc_curve,
        alphas=alpha_curve,
        ms=Mvalue_curve,
        Ws=W_curve
    );

    // PSD after curve
    PSD_monitor PSDafter_curve(
        AT=(0, 0, 20.0001),
        RELATIVE=guide2,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nx=128,
        ny=128,
        filename="PSDafter_curve",
        xwidth=0.02,
        yheight=0.12,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // Bunker
    Guide bunker(
        AT=(0, 0, 20.1502),
        RELATIVE=guide2,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=guide2,
        w1=0.02,
        h1=0.12,
        w2=0.02,
        h2=0.12,
        l=3.43,
        R0=R0,
        Qc=Qc,
        alpha=alpha,
        m=1.6,
        W=W
    );

    // Guide 3
    Guide guide3(
        AT=(0, 0, 3.56),
        RELATIVE=bunker,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=bunker,
        w1=0.02,
        h1=0.12,
        w2=0.02,
        h2=0.12,
        l=12.275,
        R0=R0,
        Qc=Qc,
        alpha=alpha,
        m=1.6,
        W=W
    );

    // Guide 4
    Guide guide4(
        AT=(0, 0, 15.8555),
        RELATIVE=bunker,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=guide3,
        w1=0.02,
        h1=0.12,
        w2=0.02,
        h2=0.12,
        l=5.66,
        R0=R0,
        Qc=Qc,
        alpha=alpha,
        m=1.6,
        W=W
    );

    // Window 1
    Al_window window1(
        AT=(0, 0, 5.66 + 1e-9),
        RELATIVE=guide4,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        thickness=0.002
    );

    // Y distribution monitor
    PSDlin_monitor ydist_fluxpos(
        AT=(0, 0, 5.66 + 1e-8 + 0.01),
        RELATIVE=guide4,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 90),
        RELATIVE=window1,
        nbins=11,
        filename="ydist_fluxpos.dat",
        xwidth=0.120,
        yheight=0.02,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // PSD flux position
    PSD_monitor PSD_fluxpos(
        AT=(0, 0, 5.66 + 1e-7 + 0.01),
        RELATIVE=guide4,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nx=100,
        ny=100,
        filename="xdist_fluxposy.dat",
        xwidth=0.02,
        yheight=0.12,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // X distribution monitor
    PSDlin_monitor xdist_flux_pos(
        AT=(0, 0, 1e-9),
        RELATIVE=PSD_fluxpos,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nbins=11,
        filename="xdist_fluxpos.dat",
        xwidth=0.020,
        yheight=0.12,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // PSD flux position B
    PSD_monitor PSD_fluxposB(
        AT=(0, 0, 6.24 - 1e-7 - 0.01),
        RELATIVE=guide4,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nx=100,
        ny=100,
        filename="PSD_fluxposB.dat",
        xwidth=0.02,
        yheight=0.12,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // Window 2
    Al_window window2(
        AT=(0, 0, 1e-9),
        RELATIVE=PSD_fluxposB,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        thickness=0.002
    );

    // In slit
    Slit in_slit(
        AT=(0, 0, 0.0021),
        RELATIVE=window2,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        xmin=-0.01,
        xmax=0.01,
        ymin=-0.06,
        ymax=0.06
    );

    // Wavelength monitor at in_slit
    L_monitor lambda_in(
        AT=(0, 0, 0.001),
        RELATIVE=in_slit,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nL=128,
        filename="L_in.dat",
        xmin=-0.011,
        xmax=0.011,
        ymin=-0.061,
        ymax=0.061,
        Lmin=0,
        Lmax=2 * lambda,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // SMA arm
    Arm sma(
        AT=(0, 0, 0.65),
        RELATIVE=in_slit,
        ROTATED=(0, OMA, 0),
        RELATIVE=in_slit
    );

    // Focused monochromator
    Monochromator_2foc foc_mono(
        AT=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=sma,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        zwidth=0.05,
        yheight=y_mono,
        gap=0.0005,
        NH=1,
        NV=NV,
        mosaich=38,
        mosaicv=38,
        r0=0.7,
        Q=mono_q,
        RV=RV,
        RH=0,
        SPLIT=10
    );

    // MSA arm
    Arm msa(
        AT=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=sma,
        ROTATED=(0, TTM, 0),
        RELATIVE=in_slit
    );

    // Out1 slit
    Slit out1_slit(
        AT=(0, 0, 0.2),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        xmin=-0.01,
        xmax=0.01,
        ymin=-0.06,
        ymax=0.06
    );

    // Amoin slit
    Slit Amoin_slit(
        AT=(0, 0, 0.325),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        xmin=-0.01,
        xmax=0.01,
        ymin=-0.06,
        ymax=0.06
    );

    // Bmoin slit
    Slit Bmoin_slit(
        AT=(0, 0, 0.525),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        xmin=-0.01,
        xmax=0.01,
        ymin=-0.06,
        ymax=0.06
    );

    // Out2 slit
    Slit out2_slit(
        AT=(0, 0, 0.65),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        xmin=-0.01,
        xmax=0.01,
        ymin=-0.06,
        ymax=0.06
    );

    // PSD at sample
    PSD_monitor PSD_sample(
        AT=(0, 0, 2.77),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nx=80,
        ny=80,
        filename="PSD_sample.dat",
        xmin=-0.05,
        xmax=0.05,
        ymin=-0.07,
        ymax=0.07,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // Wavelength monitor at sample
    L_monitor lambda_sample(
        AT=(0, 0, 2.81),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        nL=128,
        filename="L_sample.dat",
        xmin=-sample_radius,
        xmax=sample_radius,
        ymin=-sample_height / 2,
        ymax=sample_height / 2,
        Lmin=lambda - 0.2,
        Lmax=lambda + 0.2,
        restore_neutron=1
    );

    // Sample arm
    Arm sa_arm(
        AT=(0, 0, 2.82),
        RELATIVE=msa,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=msa
    );

    // Sample
    PowderN sample(
        AT=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=sa_arm,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE_ABSOLUTE,
        reflections=filename,
        radius=sample_radius,
        yheight=sample_height,
        pack=PACK,
        p_inc=0,
        p_transmit=0,
        DW=Dw,
        d_phi=D_PHI,
        barns=BARNS
    );

    // Beamstop
    Beamstop STOP(
        AT=(0, 0, 1.4),
        RELATIVE=sa_arm,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=sa_arm,
        radius=0.3
    );

    // Detector
    Monitor_nD Detector(
        AT=(0, 0, 0),
        RELATIVE=sa_arm,
        ROTATED=(0, 0, 180),
        RELATIVE=sa_arm,
        xwidth=3.0,
        yheight=0.09,
        bins=400,
        min=19.9 + SHIFT,
        max=99.9 + SHIFT,
        options="banana,theta",
        filename="detector.dat"
    );
}
